source: Public transmitted Chinese Wikisource three volumes. Bilingual interpretation cross-reference xingge.tw/en/quanshu

records.historical_source_meaning: A Ming Jiajing-era preface identifies a claimed older transmitted compilation; it is evidence of book transmission, not proof Chen Tuan personally authored these surviving passages.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: tradition/compilation provenance unresolved

records.historical_source_meaning: Text states stars are distributed among twelve celestial/palace enclosures; birth Life and Body conditions and dignity modify outcomes.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: literal physical sky-star interpretations not presumed

records.historical_source_meaning: Original expressly warns even traditionally auspicious placement must consider productive/destructive relations, palace dignity and change.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: bare single-star prediction insufficient

records.historical_source_meaning: Original says Zi Wei and Tian Fu depend on assistance of Fu/Bi stars for full auspicious potency.
records.source_precondition: Zi Wei/Tian Fu and Zuo Fu/You Bi configuration
records.uncertainty_or_exception: specific same-palace vs trine conjunction needs line-level nuance

records.historical_source_meaning: Sun at Wu palace appears as a favorable rank/wealth trope in transmitted verse.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: social rank and old economic roles require independent outcomes

records.historical_source_meaning: Volume I contains individual question-answer entries for Zi Wei, Tian Ji, Sun, Wu Qu, Tian Fu and other major stars and transformations.
records.source_precondition: star identity and quoted entry context
records.uncertainty_or_exception: different attributed answer/commentary layers may disagree

records.historical_source_meaning: Hua Lu, Hua Quan, Hua Ke and Hua Ji are separately discussed as named transformed states, not merely generic good/bad stars.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: year vs month stem and school table variants not yet chosen

records.historical_source_meaning: First volume records patterns across multiple stars/palaces and separate poem on women's charts.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: gendered historic labels not modern validated personal characteristics

records.historical_source_meaning: Life palace is counted from Yin for first lunar month, forward to birth month, then backward from Zi hour to birth hour.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: late-Zi convention and conversion must be frozen

records.historical_source_meaning: Body palace starts from same month anchor and counts forward from Zi hour to birth hour.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: direction differs deliberately from Life palace

records.historical_source_meaning: Classical line gives intercalary month handling relative to following month in palace placements.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: not universal across modern charts; preserve original against alternate conventions

records.historical_source_meaning: Original enumerates Life, Siblings, Wife/Concubines, Children, Wealth, Illness, Travel, Servants, Career, Property, Fortune, Parents as twelve sectors.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: period household and gender categories require neutral test outcomes

records.historical_source_meaning: Original warns placing twelve palaces in reverse progression; not interchangeable with palace order in clockwise diagrams.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: chart orientation and branch indexing separately specified

records.historical_source_meaning: Original provides five Year-Stem pairs for starting palace stem at Yin (e.g., Jia/Ji starts Bing-Yin).
records.source_precondition: sexagenary birth-year stem and branch placements
records.uncertainty_or_exception: mathematical parity untested; century/year boundary convention unresolved

records.historical_source_meaning: 60 cycle Na Yin is used to find one of five bureau categories involved in Zi Wei star placement.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: must implement table from original, do not borrow BaZi's Day Master elemental balance

records.historical_source_meaning: Second volume contains a named section for each of the 12 palaces, not one freeform personality pool.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: no single palace substitute for independent behavior measure

records.historical_source_meaning: Volume III instructs astrologer to inspect Life palace first for star dignity, transformation and generating/control.
records.source_precondition: Life palace and associated major stars
records.uncertainty_or_exception: hierarchical rule priority; not claim of measured human accuracy

records.historical_source_meaning: Next the reader evaluates Body lord and relationships after the Life palace, rather than only calendar-animal identity.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: exact star placement needs independent implementation

records.historical_source_meaning: Third evaluate Travel, Wealth, Career trinal configuration and malefic/aspected testimony.
records.source_precondition: Life/Body and San Fang Si Zheng
records.uncertainty_or_exception: no independent forecast accuracy

records.historical_source_meaning: Fourth evaluate Fortune palace and beneficial/malefic stars, explicitly connected to Wealth opposite sector.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: historical moral/wealth labels are not verified facts

records.historical_source_meaning: Original says Life palace lacking primary stars can still receive favorable judgment when benefic Wealth and Career palaces illuminate it.
records.source_precondition: Life lacks principal star + wealth/career supporting stars
records.uncertainty_or_exception: prevents false universal 'empty Life = bad' inference

records.historical_source_meaning: Original classifies high/medium/low star quality and numerical configuration producing a nine-cell combination scheme.
records.source_precondition: both star formation and number/Yin-Yang five-phase grading
records.uncertainty_or_exception: ranking is transmitted rhetoric, no calibrated modern percentile

records.historical_source_meaning: Original has a distinct section for ten-year luck periods beyond the natal fixed chart.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: decade rules not yet transcribed or verified against independent engine

records.historical_source_meaning: Original separately discusses annual Tai Sui and year stars.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: must not merge calendar-year animal or BaZi decade luck methods

records.historical_source_meaning: Original contains a separate historical male/female chart comparison.
records.uncertainty_or_exception: not evidence of biology, identity, sexuality or modern gender traits

records.historical_source_meaning: Original has a dedicated section stressing verification of actual birth hour.
records.source_precondition: birth clock precision and local calendars
records.uncertainty_or_exception: uncertain time requires multi-chart interval not best-fitting choice

options: traditional next-month for palace rule in transmitted Quan Shu

classification: Chinese original chapter/verse structure, not complete executable chart or forecasts
